label: Person
name: Marcus Calpurnius Flamma
summary:
Marcus Calpurnius Flamma was a Roman military leader and hero in the First Punic War.

Born into a distinguished family of the Patrician class, Flamma's early life and career are shrouded in mystery. Despite this, his bravery and strategic prowess during the First Punic War against Carthage earned him significant recognition among his peers and superiors.

As a key figure in Roman military leadership, Flamma played a crucial role in several pivotal battles, including the Battle of Agrigentum, where he led the Roman forces to victory. His actions not only contributed significantly to Rome's dominance but also set a precedent for future generations of Roman military leaders.

Flamma's legacy extends beyond his military achievements; he is remembered as a champion of Roman values and a defender of the Republic.

"The gods have ordained me to serve Rome, and I shall honor them by defending our great nation against all threats." - Marcus Calpurnius Flamma (attributed quote)
